backend/main.mo: Main actor for the social media backend, defining types and state for posts, comments, user profiles, notifications, messaging, and follows, with authorization and blob storage mixins included.
backend/migration.mo: Data migration module that defines old and new actor state shapes for schema evolution; the current `run` function is a no-op passthrough since the schemas are identical.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (functional chat/messages page, follow/shadows system, notifications panel) to their source files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, used as build planning documentation.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file with Tailwind directives and OKLCH-based CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that sets the page title to 'InstaV' and mounts the React app via the `/src/main.tsx` module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app with ThemeProvider (dark default), InternetIdentityProvider, React Query's QueryClientProvider, the router, and a Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AvatarPlaceholde: Avatar component that renders a profile picture from an ExternalBlob URL or falls back to gradient initials, supporting xs/sm/md/lg/xl sizes and both legacy and new prop names.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with six route links (Home, Explore, ShortSport, Messages, Create, Profile), hiding on the shortsport route and showing a dot badge on Messages when conversations exist.
frontend/src/components/CommentsSheet.ts: A bottom sheet component for displaying and submitting comments on a post, supporting both open/onOpenChange and isOpen/onClose prop conventions.
frontend/src/components/editor/AudioPane: Panel component for managing audio tracks in the editor, supporting file upload, recording toggle, per-track volume/mute controls, and track removal.
frontend/src/components/editor/DesignPan: Panel for configuring canvas aspect ratio, solid background colors, and gradient presets, applying changes to the first clip in the editor state.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorCan: Canvas component that renders the current video frame including background color, text layers, sticker layers, filters, vignette, glitch, and letterbox effects using the HTML5 Canvas API.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorTim: Timeline component displaying a scrubable ruler, video clip tracks with color coding, playhead indicator, clip removal, and the ability to add blank clips.
frontend/src/components/editor/EffectsPa: Panel for toggling a set of predefined motion graphic effects (e.g., glitch, confetti, letterbox) on the editor state, with a display of currently active effects.
frontend/src/components/editor/ExportPan: Panel for exporting a video clip, allowing the user to set a title and description, preview the video, and download it; also directs users to Create Post for public sharing.
frontend/src/components/editor/FiltersPa: React panel component for applying image/video filter presets (e.g., Moody, Noir, Cinematic) and manually adjusting individual filter settings like brightness, contrast, saturation, and vignette via sliders.
frontend/src/components/editor/StickersP: React panel component for browsing emoji stickers by category, adding them as timed overlay layers to the editor, and editing selected sticker properties like size and rotation.
frontend/src/components/editor/TextPanel: React panel component for adding and editing text overlay layers with controls for font, size, color, alignment, bold/italic, and entrance animation.
frontend/src/components/editor/Transitio: React panel component that displays a library of video transitions (fade, slide, zoom, etc.) and allows applying them between consecutive clips in the editor timeline.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a TopBar, a router Outlet, and a BottomNav.
frontend/src/components/NotificationsPan: A dropdown panel that lists user notifications (follow and message types) with read/unread state, timestamps, and navigation on click.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: A card component for displaying a single post with author info, media, like/comment/view actions, and intersection-observer-based view recording.
A dialog modal that shows a grid of the current user's posts as thumbnails, allowing selection of one to share in a message.
frontend/src/components/TopBar.tsx: A sticky top navigation bar showing the page title, brand logo, a notifications bell with unread badge, and a login/logout button.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A UI card component for displaying a video post with thumbnail, author info, like/bookmark/share actions, and a double-tap like animation using mock data types.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom React hook and context provider that manages Internet Identity authentication state, exposing login/logout functions and status flags backed by DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including user profiles, posts, comments, notifications, and messages via the ICP actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, imports Inter and Syne fonts, and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark mode color themes.
frontend/src/lib/mockData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static mock data arrays for posts, comments, users, messages, and conversations used for UI development and testing.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility functions for class name merging (cn), number formatting (K/M), time formatting, and relative time display (timeAgo).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Page component for creating a new post, supporting file upload or URL input for media, caption entry, and submission via the createPost mutation.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Full-featured video/design editor page with panels for filters, effects, stickers, design, timeline, and export, managing a rich EditorState with clips, text layers, and audio tracks.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Explore page with a search bar and tabs to browse/filter all posts or search users by handle, with debounced query and navigation to user profiles.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Main feed page that fetches and displays all posts as PostCard components, with a comments sheet that opens when a post is clicked.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Full messaging page with a conversation list sidebar and a message thread view, supporting text messages and shared post previews with unread counts.
frontend/src/pages/MessageThreadPage.tsx: Thin wrapper page that extracts a principalId route param and renders MessagesPage with that principal pre-selected.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Authenticated user's own profile page with editable profile fields, a post grid, and follower/following counts; also handles first-time profile setup.
frontend/src/pages/ShortSportPage.tsx: TikTok-style vertical video reel page that auto-plays the active video post, tracks visible reel via IntersectionObserver, and supports mute toggling and optimistic likes.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: Public profile page for viewing another user by handle or principal, showing their posts grid, follower/following counts, and follow/unfollow/message actions.
frontend/src/routeTree.ts: Defines the TanStack Router route tree for the frontend, mapping URL paths to page components (Feed, Explore, Editor, Profile, ShortSport, CreatePost, UserProfile, Messages, MessageThread) under a shared Layout root.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL bar without a page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode support, custom OKLCH-based color tokens (primary, secondary, sidebar, chart, etc.), border radius variables, accordion keyframe animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state for a sports social app (ShortSport + Feed), documenting existing features (chat, follow/Shadows system, notifications), architectural notes (Internet Identity auth, polling-based chat), and known issues.
